about.title: The right partner for demanding requirements.
about.body: GPMB, Lda is a Mozambican company specialising in maintenance parts and materials for commercial, industrial and domestic use. We provide accessible solutions, professional service and strong relationships with strategic suppliers.
about.mission: To be a company of excellence in the sectors where we operate, committed to innovation, quality and efficiency in the national market.
about.vision: To be recognised for solid, effective service and relevant solutions for partners and clients, from Mozambique to Africa.
about.commitment: We aim to exceed client expectations through quality and safety, preventing risks to people, health and property while preserving the environment.
